groups.definition: Rapid technological change, shortened product life cycles and competition may render products obsolete and require costly R&D investments that may not generate returns.
New entrants and technologies such as EVs, autonomous vehicles, ridesharing and software services may disrupt the core vehicle business model if the company fails to commercialize them successfully.
Intense pricing pressure on older-technology products, combined with contractual obligations to keep producing them, may lead to margin compression and losses.
